description:
Get ready for the world's first look at an Intel Panther Lake powered Mini PC! In today's video, we take the all-new Kudos Mind Pro, featuring the Core Ultra X7 358H, and pair it with the incredible Mind Graphics 2 dock.This isn't your standard eGPU setup. The Mind Graphics 2 uses a proprietary "Mind Link" PCIe 5.0 x4 connection (128 GT/s), making it significantly faster than Thunderbolt 4 or 5. It packs a desktop-class RTX 5060 Ti with a massive 16GB of VRAM, turning this tiny PC into a powerhouse for 1440p gaming and a serious local AI workstation.
